"""Every event followed by an audit: strongest state-equivalence test."""
import json, random, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import fuzz, verify as V
from protocol import validate, loads

def with_audits(case, limit=256):
    ev=[]
    for e in case['events']:
        ev.append(e)
        ev.append({'op':'audit'})
        if len(ev)>=limit: break
    return ev

def main(count=80, seed=3):
    rnd=random.Random(seed)
    fails=0
    gens=[fuzz.rand_case, fuzz.rand_case_active, fuzz.rand_case_transport]
    t0=time.time()
    for trial in range(count):
        n=rnd.randint(1,2)
        cases=[]
        for _ in range(n):
            g=rnd.choice(gens)
            c=g(rnd, big=(trial%2==0)) if g is not fuzz.rand_case_transport else g(rnd)
            c=dict(c); c['events']=with_audits(c)
            cases.append(c)
        req={'cases':cases}
        try: validate(json.loads(json.dumps(req)))
        except Exception: continue
        p=fuzz.run_child(req)
        if p.returncode:
            print('exit',trial,p.stderr.decode()[:800]); fails+=1; continue
        try:
            V.verify(req, loads(p.stdout), validate)
        except V.Bad as exc:
            fails+=1
            print('trial',trial,'VERIFY',exc)
            open('/workspace/failures/audit%d.json'%trial,'w').write(json.dumps(req))
        except Exception:
            import traceback; traceback.print_exc(); fails+=1
    print('audit-fuzz failures',fails,'of',count,'time',round(time.time()-t0,1))
    return fails
if __name__=='__main__':
    sys.exit(1 if main(int(sys.argv[1]), int(sys.argv[2])) else 0)
PYEOF
